notes: The phone and the web finally agree. The website was never re-reading your account - it loaded once when you opened the tab and then only ever wrote, so a tab left open showed you yesterday. Your work orders always matched, which made it look like everything was syncing when your inventory was not. Both ends now watch your account continuously. Your lists could also lose things: inventory, fleet ops, hauls, shopping lists, roster and crew templates were saved as one lump, so whichever device saved last replaced the whole list. They now merge item by item. Acquired and starred blueprints never synced at all, along with dashboard quick actions and saved ship loadouts - they travel with your account now. One thing to know: the first sync after updating keeps both sides' items rather than guessing what was meant to be gone, so something you had already removed on the other device can come back, including ore the app itself removed when you sold or crafted with it. Check your inventory once after updating and delete anything that should not be there.
